newsitem.title: DUBAI: Most UAE shares steady, select blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Most UAE shares steady, select blue chips gain.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial United Arab Emirates (UAE) stock market ended the week to Thursday mostly steady in trade that saw some select stocks score big gains, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose by around one percent to 2,562.29 from 2,533.36 two weeks ago. There was no trade last Thursday due to a public holiday.
Eleven shares rose, four fell and the rest remained steady.

Among major gainers were NBAD, Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company and Abu Dhabi National Hotels Company, which each ended 15 dirhams higher than levels seen at the beginning of the month at a respective 530, 1,075 and 110 dirhams.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained 10 dirhams in the fortnight to 975. Commercial Bank of Dubai was up six dirhams at 66 dirhams.
Al-Khazna Insurance lost 10 dirhams, to close at 290 from 300 dirhams on May 1 and Dubai Islamic Bank -- one of the world's biggest Islamic banks -- lost five dirhams to 155.
